Three suppliers have an indexed price cap clause in their supplier agreement (Clause 6, Pricing: "Unit prices are subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by the consumer price index and capped at four percent"):

1. **Acme Components** — supplier-agreement-acme.docx
2. **Borealis Metals** — supplier-agreement-borealis.docx
3. **Corvid Plastics** — supplier-agreement-corvid.docx

All other reviewed supplier agreements (Dunmore Industrial, and the numbered agreements 005, 010, 015, 020, 025, 030, 035, 040, 045, 050, 055, 060, 065) instead state under Clause 6 that "Unit prices are fixed for the term and are not indexed" — i.e., no price cap.

(These are single-page docx files with no page numbers in the index; cited via document title only.)
